title: DALL·E 3
short_description: DALL·E 3 generates images from text prompts, helping nonprofits create custom visuals quickly without design skills.
long_description: DALL·E 3 is an AI-based image generation tool that creates visuals from text prompts. It enables nonprofit organisations to generate custom images for communication, campaigns, and content without requiring design expertise.

title: Daanveda
short_description: Donor and fundraising CRM for Indian NGOs.
long_description: Daanveda is a donor and fundraising management platform built for Indian NGOs. It provides features like donation tracking, receipts, and compliance management.

title: Dalgo
long_description: Dalgo is an open-source data platform developed by Project Tech4Dev. It is designed to assist non-profit organizations in managing and analyzing data from multiple sources. The platform aims to streamline data pipelines, facilitate dashboarding, and help generate program insights using data.

title: Danamojo
short_description: Digital fundraising and donation management platform for nonprofits
long_description: Danamojo is a platform designed for nonprofit organisations in India to collect donations online, run fundraising campaigns, and maintain donor records in a structured way.

title: DeepL
short_description: Translation and language support for NGOs and social purpose organisations.
long_description: DeepL is an AI-powered machine translation service known for its high-quality and nuanced translations. It uses neural network technology to provide accurate and natural-sounding translations across multiple languages.

title: Descript
short_description: Audio and video editing tool for nonprofits.
long_description: Descript is a multimedia editing platform that enables users to record, transcribe, and edit audio and video content. It allows editing through text transcripts, simplifying traditional editing workflows.

title: DeskPro
short_description: Omnichannel helpdesk for tickets, chat, knowledge base, and automation.
long_description: DeskPro is an omnichannel support and helpdesk software platform designed to automate solutions like ticketing, live chat, knowledge base management, and AI‑powered workflows to simplify tasks such as customer inquiry consolidation, agent collaboration, SLA automation, and performance reporting, all in one place.

title: DigitalOcean
short_description: Developer-friendly cloud with simple pricing for VMs, DBs, and Kubernetes.
long_description: DigitalOcean is a developer‑friendly cloud platform focused on simplicity and predictable billing. It offers a range of services including Droplets (VMs), managed databases, Kubernetes, and storage.

title: Document360
short_description: Knowledge-base platform for product docs and SOPs.
long_description: Document360 is a knowledge-management platform for creating, managing, and publishing self-service knowledge bases, including documentation, SOPs, and user manuals.

title: Dropbox
short_description: Cloud storage and file-sync service for individuals and teams.
long_description: Dropbox is a cloud storage service that allows users to store, share, and access files across devices. It provides features for file synchronization, collaboration, and secure file sharing, catering to both individual and business needs.

title: ERP Next for HR
short_description: HR module within ERPNext for employees, payroll, and leave.
long_description: ERPNext for HR is the human resources management module within the broader ERPNext enterprise resource planning software. It provides functionalities for employee management, payroll, leave and attendance tracking, expense claims, and recruitment within an integrated ERP system.

title: ERP4Impact
short_description: Financial management and donor tracking platform for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: ERP4Impact is a cloud-based financial management and donor tracking platform used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations in India to manage donations, grants, and compliance requirements within a single system.

title: ERPNext
short_description: Open-source HR and workforce management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: ERPNext is an open-source Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that includes a Human Resource Management (HR) module for managing employee data, payroll, attendance, and workforce processes. It enables organisations to integrate HR with finance, accounting, and operations within a single system.

title: Eduapp
short_description: Education management platform for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Eduapp is an education management platform that supports organisations running schools, coaching centres, or learning programmes in managing student data, attendance, fees, and parent communication through a single integrated system. This can be relevant for organisations managing student cohorts across multiple centres or locations.

title: Edusystem
short_description: LMS with curriculum-aligned digital content across school subjects.
long_description: EduSystem is a learning management system that offers up-to-date digital curricular content for the core subjects of Math, Science, History, Social Studies, Spanish, and English. All courses provide lessons that incorporate a variety of digital resources such as interactive presentations, practice activities, assignments, assessments, links, and multimedia. The content allows alignment to the standards and expectations of each subject and level.

title: ElevenLabs
short_description: AI voice platform for realistic text-to-speech and voice cloning.
long_description: ElevenLabs is an AI-powered voice technology company specializing in realistic voice synthesis and voice cloning. It provides tools to generate natural-sounding speech from text and can replicate voices with high fidelity.

title: Esper
short_description: Platform to manage fleets of Android devices remotely.
long_description: Esper.io provides a platform for managing and securing fleets of Android devices. It offers tools for device provisioning, remote control, application deployment, and security management, primarily for dedicated device environments.

title: FactoHR
short_description: HR, payroll, and training management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: FactoHR is a cloud-based Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, compliance, recruitment, and employee performance within a single system. It includes an integrated Learning Management System (LMS) module for tracking staff training alongside HR operations.

title: Firki
short_description: Teacher professional development platform for educators and education NGOs.
long_description: Firki is a free online teacher education platform built by Teach For India that enables educators to access structured courses, webinars, peer learning, and mentorship for continuous professional development.

title: Flux
short_description: Workflow and job orchestration platform with scheduling and event triggers.
long_description: Flux by Flux Corporation is a workflow automation platform that provides tools to design, execute, and monitor complex business processes. It offers features like job scheduling, event-based triggers, process orchestration, and real-time monitoring, managed through a centralized interface.

title: Frappe Framework
short_description: Low-code, Python/JS web app framework used for ERPNext.
long_description: Frappe Framework is a full‑stack, metadata‑driven, low‑code web application framework built in Python and JavaScript. It enables rapid development of modular ERP solutions through declarative data modeling and offers a powerful admin UI for managing applications.

title: Fuel a Dream
short_description: Crowdfunding platform for projects and causes
long_description: Fuel a Dream is a crowdfunding platform that enables individuals and organisations to raise funds for social, creative, and innovation-led projects through campaign-based fundraising.

title: GIMP
short_description: Open-source raster graphics editor for image editing and compositing.
long_description: GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a free and open-source raster graphics editor. It is used for image retouching, image composition, and image authoring, supporting various image formats and providing a range of editing tools.

title: Gamma
short_description: Tool for creating interactive decks, docs, and simple web pages with smart design defaults.
long_description: Gamma is a new media format that allows users to create engaging and interactive presentations, documents, and web pages without coding. It focuses on intelligent design and visual storytelling to simplify content creation.

title: Gemini
short_description: AI assistance for content and media generation for nonprofits
long_description: Gemini is an AI-powered assistant developed by Google that supports content creation, summarisation, and media-related tasks. It helps organisations generate and refine content that can be used across text, images, and presentations.

title: GitHub Copilot
short_description: AI coding assistant that suggests code and functions directly inside supported editors.
long_description: GitHub Copilot is an AI pair programmer developed by GitHub and OpenAI that assists developers by suggesting code and entire functions in real-time. It integrates with code editors and draws context from comments and code to provide relevant suggestions.

title: Give India
short_description: Donation platform to give to vetted Indian NGOs with impact tracking.
long_description: GiveIndia by GiveIndia is a donation platform that provides a channel for individuals and institutions to contribute to verified NGOs across India. It offers features like cause-based fundraising, payroll giving, impact tracking, and tax-exempt donation receipts, managed through a web-based interface.

title: Glific
short_description: WhatsApp-based communication platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Glific is an open-source platform that enables nonprofits and social purpose organisations to engage beneficiaries through WhatsApp, supporting two-way communication, information delivery, and feedback collection at scale.

title: Google Analytics
short_description: Web analytics service for traffic, behavior, and campaign performance.
long_description: Google Analytics is a web-analytics service offering real-time and historical data on website traffic, user behavior, and marketing ROI through customizable dashboards and reports.

title: Google BigQuery
short_description: Cloud data warehouse for large-scale data storage and analysis
long_description: Google Cloud BigQuery is a serverless cloud data warehouse that enables organisations to store and analyse large datasets using SQL. It allows users to run complex queries, store and manage vast amounts of data, and integrate with various data analytics and business intelligence tools.

title: Google Cloud
short_description: Google's cloud platform for compute, storage, data, ML, and developer tools.
long_description: Google Cloud is a suite of cloud computing services that runs on the same infrastructure Google uses internally for its end-user products. It offers a range of services including computing, storage, networking, big data, machine learning, and developer tools.

title: Google Forms
short_description: A free, browser-based form and survey tool used by NGOs for intake, volunteer registration, and operational data capture.
long_description: Google Forms is a free, browser-based form and survey tool used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to collect beneficiary data, registrations, and operational information in real time through Google Sheets.

title: Google Groups
short_description: Email-based discussion and forum service by Google.
long_description: Google Groups is a service from Google that allows users to create and participate in online discussion forums and email-based groups. It facilitates communication, collaboration, and information sharing among members with shared interests or projects.

title: Google Lighthouse
short_description: Automated auditing tool for web performance, accessibility, and SEO.
long_description: Google Lighthouse is an open-source, automated tool for improving the quality of web pages. It audits web pages for performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO, and progressive web apps, providing reports and suggestions for improvements.

title: Google Looker Studio
short_description: An interactive dashboarding tool for data visualisation and reporting.
long_description:
Google Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio) is a free, web-based data visualisation and reporting tool developed by Google. It enables organisations to transform raw data into interactive dashboards and shareable reports.

It connects to multiple data sources and presents information through charts, graphs, and tables, helping teams monitor performance and communicate insights effectively.

title: Google Meet
short_description: Google video-meeting service integrated with Workspace.
long_description: Google Meet is a secure, cloud-based video conferencing service by Google LLC that enables real-time meetings with features such as screen sharing, live captions, and seamless integration with Google Workspace apps.

title: Google Sheets
short_description: Cloud-based spreadsheet tool for data management and lightweight programme workflows
long_description:
Google Sheets is a cloud-based spreadsheet tool used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to manage programme data, track operations, and generate reports collaboratively.

While not a dedicated data collection platform, it is widely used as a flexible data management layer, often combined with tools like Google Forms or external survey platforms.

title: Google Workspace
short_description: Cloud-based productivity and collaboration suite for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Google Workspace is a suite of cloud-based productivity and collaboration tools that includes applications for email (Gmail), word processing (Docs), spreadsheets (Sheets), presentations (Slides), cloud storage (Drive), and video conferencing (Meet). It enables real-time collaboration and remote work.
